title: Minority LLC member squeeze-out under a fiduciary-duty waiver

traps.title: Pleading fiduciary duty
traps.why_wrong: §7.3 waiver under §18-1101(c); only implied covenant and express terms survive; pushback pushes to plead anyway

traps.title: Missing the capital-call defect (the best claim)
traps.wrong_move: Treating the dilution as valid and the book-value offer as binding
traps.why_wrong: §6.3 requires certified mail + email and a bona fide stated purpose; delivered by text; email bounced → no Dilution Event; §9.2 not triggered
traps.harm: Client accepts $189k for an interest worth ~$1.76M

traps.title: Fee claim pleaded as direct
traps.wrong_move: Direct claim for the affiliate fees
traps.why_wrong: Company harmed → derivative (Tooley); demand futility pleadable

traps.title: Limitations ignored
traps.wrong_move: Suing on all five years of fees as of right
traps.why_wrong: 3-year statute: $375,000.00 (2022–2023) presumptively barred absent tolling; concealment/non-disclosure argument

traps.title: Rejecting the offer reflexively / accepting it
traps.why_wrong: Negotiated exit above book is realistic; the defect letter must go before Oct 31

oracle.item: fiduciary-duty claim marked survives_waiver = false (not recommended for pleading)
capital-call §6.3 defect claim present, direct, strong
affiliate-fee claim: derivative; limitations barred_portion ≈ 375,000 with tolling argument
strategy: do not accept $189,100; act before Oct 31

rubric: Pushback answered: why pleading a waived claim hurts; what survives
